user.title: Set up Cabane
user.description:
Open **Cabane** from the sidebar to draw your floor plan, view your home in 3D, and connect devices. Cabane uses your existing Home Assistant sign-in.

**Save and sync**
A workspace includes your home, drafts, and device mappings. To save it on this Home Assistant instance and sync across browsers, enable Home Assistant storage and choose **Save** in Cabane.

**Shared access**
Every signed-in user on this instance can view, edit, and delete workspaces saved to Home Assistant.

**Already using cabane.my?**
Your homes do not appear here automatically. Import them from Home Assistant storage or a workspace backup.
